item.title: Self-hosted ingress is not a free service
Aeza wants an email, not a card, and states its traffic term
Worldstream's entry server is EUR 49, not the EUR 104 on its banner
Cloud.ru's free VM stopped accepting registrations on 2026-06-30
Hetzner's dedicated range publishes prices, so it is paid-only and not a qualifying tier
NAVER's KRW 200,000 credit is for students and staff of a participating institution
Lizard's USD 19 plan is a fee, not a free tier
boat has a free trial, and its own pages disagree about its shape
Modal's free credit resets monthly, so it is an allowance and not a trial
Tencent Cloud Studio gives a monthly minute allowance, not a paid-only product
GitHub Actions public repositories are free and unlimited; the 2,000 minutes are private
Google Colab's free tier is a standing service, not a trial
Hugging Face Spaces has a free lane, and the ZeroGPU allowance recurs daily
Kamatera's trial needs a card, not an email
Neon's 100 CU-hours are per project, not per account
Railway has a permanent free plan beside its 30-day trial
Lightning AI's free Studio is dead, and the pricing page still sells it
Own the disk is not an option
Mistral's AI-cloud page is a 404, and the record sold it as paid capacity
Six records said paid-only about a page that offers a free start
Nineteen records called a credit a tier, or a tier a credit
Yggdrasil has no exit nodes, so its 2.16 TB a day reaches no reader
Xcode Cloud includes 25 compute hours a month, and the record called it paid-only
OVH's public cloud has no free instance, and the record priced it as one
Azure's free compute is a monthly vCPU-second allowance, and three records carried the credit instead
Google Cloud's free tier is a recurring usage allowance, and the record priced it as a credit
Lambda's free tier is 400,000 GB-seconds a month, not a USD 6.87 credit
Decided on 2026-10-22: compute/gitpod, compute/kaggle, storage/pulsedmedia-m10g-storage-box and 1 more record
Abacus.AI's ladder was readable all along and has no free tier on it
StepFun's USD 9.99 tier was live, and a month-old date error hid the cheapest plan in the market
Devin and Windsurf were never dead; HTTP 404 was read as a vendor death
Hurricane Electric's free DNS was recorded with `interface: rest` beside a detail field saying it has no REST API
deSEC was recorded as having no published cap and recommended for many zones, and a new account gets one domain
CockroachDB Basic's trial was recorded as ending in "interruption", and it ends in an unrecoverable deletion
Turso's free plan was recorded as having no idle clock, and it archives an inactive database after 10 days
Aiven's free plan was recorded as the one that never pauses, and it powers off on inactivity
EUR 8.21 per TB was the dollar figure, and the ratio built on it was the wrong ratio
Two throughput numbers for one host cannot both stand: the CDN read path is cache state, not a rate
The 100 MB body cap is not a tunnel limit, and a 400 MiB body traversed a Quick Tunnel
Kimi and zai ladders do not match
Trae's USD 3 Lite tier never existed, and its Pro price was half the real one
